observations.why: Imperative command to discard carries urgency and negative valence — the speaker is actively expelling something, not calmly noting it.
Reinforcing imperative with sweeping scope ('all knowledge') sustains the same urgent, negative-valence purge stance as the prior directive.
Flat declarative correcting a record — low arousal, negative valence; the settled, corrective tone contrasts with the urgent imperatives above.
